content: The use of a 9% NaCl solution as a rinse should involve a volume that is equal to or greater than the priming volume of any intravenous (IV) infusion set being used. This ensures that the maximum number of cells are infused into the patient. If more than one infusion bag is provided, the contents of each infusion bag must be completely administered before proceeding to thaw and infuse the contents of the next bag. In cases where multiple infusion bags are required, it is important not to administer more than one bag per hour.
